---
title: "Explore by area"
subtitle: "Choose a region, a combined or mayoral authority, or a local authority, and see its schools' Value Added v2.0 on a map and in a table."
toc: false
---

```{r setup}
#| include: false
source(here::here("R", "site_helpers.R"))
source(here::here("R", "explore_js.R"))
V <- load_va()
P <- readRDS(here::here("data", "place_absence.rds"))

# Combined and mayoral authorities: the ONS lookup (May 2025) for those
# established, by district; the Devolution Priority Programme areas,
# announced February 2025, by upper-tier council. A council area takes the
# authority of its districts, so schools without a district still get one.
ons <- read.csv(here::here("data", "lookups", "lad_cauth_2025.csv"))
new_ma <- read.csv(here::here("data", "lookups", "new_mayoral_authorities.csv"))
w <- va_wide(V) |> left_join(P$abs_schools |> select(URN, abs_excess), by = "URN")
la_ca <- w |> filter(!is.na(lad)) |> distinct(LANAME, lad) |>
  inner_join(ons, by = c("lad" = "LAD25NM")) |> distinct(LANAME, ca = CAUTH25NM)
la_ca <- bind_rows(la_ca, new_ma |> transmute(LANAME, ca = paste0(authority, " (new)"))) |>
  distinct(LANAME, .keep_all = TRUE)
w <- w |> left_join(la_ca, by = "LANAME")

dat <- w |>
  transmute(SCHNAME, LANAME, region = gor_name, ca, la = LANAME, lat, lon, pupils,
            va_shrunk_all, va_lo_all, va_hi_all, va_shrunk_disadvantaged, va_shrunk_non_disadvantaged,
            va_shrunk_girls, va_shrunk_boys, abs_excess, ofsted_latest,
            up = va_lo_all > 0, down = va_hi_all < 0) |>   # flags before rounding
  mutate(across(where(is.double) & !c(lat, lon), ~round(.x, 2)))
measures <- tibble::tribble(
  ~var, ~label, ~good, ~unit,
  "va_shrunk_all", "Value added, all pupils", "high", " pts",
  "va_shrunk_disadvantaged", "Value added, disadvantaged", "high", " pts",
  "va_shrunk_non_disadvantaged", "Value added, non-disadvantaged", "high", " pts",
  "va_shrunk_girls", "Value added, girls", "high", " pts",
  "va_shrunk_boys", "Value added, boys", "high", " pts",
  "abs_excess", "Absence against intake", "low", " pp")
levels <- tibble::tibble(key = c("region", "ca", "la"),
                         label = c("Region", "Combined or mayoral authority", "Local authority (upper tier)"))
notes <- setNames(as.list(rep("New mayoral strategic authority, from the Devolution Priority Programme announced in February 2025; not yet in the ONS lookup.",
                                n_distinct(new_ma$authority))), paste0(unique(new_ma$authority), " (new)"))
```

Every state-funded mainstream secondary school in England has a Value
Added v2.0 figure for all pupils, disadvantaged and non-disadvantaged
pupils, girls and boys, `r yl(min(V$spec$years))` to `r yl(max(V$spec$years))`:
Attainment 8 points against England, shrunk by reliability. Choose a
level and an area; the map zooms to its schools and the table lists them.
Click a column heading to sort. "Absence against intake" is percentage
points above (positive) or below what the school's intake predicts.

```{r explorer}
payload <- list(
  schools = jsonlite::toJSON(dat, dataframe = "rows", na = "null", digits = 6),
  levels = jsonlite::toJSON(levels, dataframe = "rows"),
  measures = jsonlite::toJSON(measures, dataframe = "rows"),
  notes = jsonlite::toJSON(notes, auto_unbox = TRUE),
  default = jsonlite::toJSON(list(level = "ca", area = "Sussex and Brighton (new)"), auto_unbox = TRUE))
leaflet::leaflet(height = 560, options = leaflet::leafletOptions(scrollWheelZoom = FALSE)) |>
  leaflet::addProviderTiles("Esri.WorldGrayCanvas") |>
  leaflet::setView(-1.5, 52.8, 6) |>
  htmlwidgets::onRender(EXPLORE_JS, data = payload)
```

Combined and mayoral authorities are from the ONS lookup of local
authority districts to combined authorities (May 2025), with the six
Devolution Priority Programme areas announced in February 2025 added and
marked "(new)". Areas not in a combined authority are not listed at that
level. The full data are in [va_v2_schools.csv](data/va_v2_schools.csv),
and the Sussex areas have [pages of their own](sussex.qmd).
